findings.evidence: `rg` hits: `StateCardinality.lean:139`, `:144`, `:150`, `:156`, `:162`, `:168`; `SmallGridGradings.lean:51`, `:63`, `:75` all use `show` only to feed `Classical.choose`/`choose_spec`.
findings.fix: Define the concrete values directly as structure literals (`⟨1⟩`, `⟨Equiv.swap ...⟩`, and the `GridDiagram` record) so the projection lemmas are `rfl`/`simp`, eliminating the undocumented `show`/`choose_spec` proof scaffolding.
findings.issue: The concrete states and diagram are defined through `Classical.choose <| show ...`, and their simp lemmas repeat the same witness; the same pattern appears in `SmallGridGradings.lean:50`, `:62`, and `:74`.

findings.evidence: `SmallGridGradings.lean:146-160` and `:164-178` repeat the `eq_twoByTwoId_or_eq_twoByTwoSwap` splits and near-identical `rw [twoByTwo...pairCard...]` chains.
findings.fix: Factor the common 2x2 grading table or a reusable lemma for the two possible `(G.O, G.X)` orientations, then have both Maslov computations reuse it with `simp`/`norm_num` instead of repeating the brittle case script.
findings.issue: `maslovXℤ_O_of_two` and `maslovOℤ_X_of_two` duplicate the same four-way classification and long ordered rewrite chains against private pair-card lemmas.

summary: The PR has proof-quality issues from avoidable opaque `choose` wrappers and duplicated small-grid case computations. These make the proofs more fragile than the concrete 2x2 computation requires.
